title: Pulled-back injective modules are acyclic for object sections
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small sites in the common universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be continuous and cocontinuous [def-weil-pbc-special-cocontinuous-functor](1), with associated geometric morphism $g:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ [def-trf-geometric-morphism] and $g^{-1}M=M\circ u$. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal D$, put $R'=g^{-1}R$, and let $I$ be an injective $R$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For $U\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)$ let $E_U$ be the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the free $R'$-module presheaf $V\mapsto\bigoplus_{a:V\to U}R'(V)$, with restriction sending the basis vector of $a$ to that of its composite with the restriction arrow. Then for every integer $p>0$ one has $\operatorname{Ext}_{R'}^p(E_U,g^{-1}I)=0$. Here $\operatorname{Ext}_{R'}^p(E_U,F)=H^p\operatorname{Hom}_{R'}(E_U,J^\bullet)$ for an injective resolution $F\to J^\bullet$, and it is the right derived functor of $F\mapsto F(U)$ under the natural identification $\operatorname{Hom}_{R'}(E_U,F)=F(U)$.

source.place: Tag 0D6X, lemma-pullback-injective-pre-limp; its module-section vanishing expressed through the free representing sheaf for evaluation, as in the Ext display in the proof of lemma-existence-derived-lower-shriek.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-free-representable-module-ext-evaluation] on $(\mathcal C,R')$. Its common-universe hypotheses are those of the item, and its $E_U$ is exactly the stated sheafification with the same basis restrictions. It supplies module injective resolutions, the normalized natural additive identification $\operatorname{Hom}_{R'}(E_U,N)=N(U)$, and $\operatorname{Ext}_{R'}^p(E_U,N)\cong H^p(U,N_{\mathrm{ab}})$ for every module sheaf $N$. This is the Ext/evaluation identification used in Stacks Tag 07AC.

Put $F=g^{-1}I$. By [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-cocontinuous-topos-adjunction], inverse image on set sheaves is precomposition and preserves finite products. Applying it to addition, zero, negation and scalar action therefore gives $R'(V)=R(uV)$ and $F(V)=I(uV)$, with restrictions $I(u(h))$. Apply [lem-trf-continuous-precomposition-injective-module-cech] to $u,R,I$: continuity and smallness are in the item, and $I$ is injective in modules. Thus $\check H^p(\mathcal U,F_{\mathrm{ab}})=0$ for every source covering and every $p>0$, the covering-level vanishing in Tag 0D6X.

Use [lem-weil-pbc-site-cech-vanishing-criterion] with $\mathcal B=\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)$ and all coverings. Every covering object and every chosen iterated fibre product belong to $\mathcal B$; every covering refines itself by identities. Step 2 verifies the remaining positive Cech vanishing hypothesis, so $H^p(U,F_{\mathrm{ab}})=0$ for all $p>0$. The comparison in step 1 gives $\operatorname{Ext}_{R'}^p(E_U,g^{-1}I)=0$. Its normalized Hom identification and module-resolution convention also give the claimed right-derived evaluation interpretation. No injectivity of $F$ or of its underlying abelian sheaf is asserted.
